label: R18-TIMING-BATCH
title: Integrate and validate three R18 timing cuts

members.goal: remove sys_commit feedback into FP TX_DONE
split pp_pre leading-one scan before pack_pre
remove kill clear enable from dead acc/acc_flags payload

scope: Cherry-pick the three disjoint R18 RTL/test lanes, resolve only integration test assumptions, then run focused T-016/T-017/T-018 tests and the complete affected L0-L2 union on one exact candidate SHA. Only after functional acceptance create a fresh remote physical probe and measure top-N/directional results.
writes: integration-only test/registry changes required to run member tests

validation.focused: T-016 core +T016_SYSKILL and Cocotb; T-017 scalar R18 SV; T-018 FP wrapper kill/reissue
validation.l0_l1: registry/lint/core/backpressure/FIFO/MMU/IRQ/maintenance/FP direct/P7-1..5/muldiv plus corrected fetch-fault semantic selftest and expected-fail BFM
validation.l2: R17 A-F union including branch-fence base/cache/FIFO-off, semantic EC21+mem2, and full P7 strict matrices
validation.physical: fresh synthesis/fitter/signoff STA/top-N after exact-SHA L0-L2 green

acceptance: All three focused lanes and the complete registered union pass on one exact SHA. New physical evidence must report whether each old cone is zero/moved and identify replacement top-N; no timing improvement is claimed from RTL structure alone.
resource: One heavy local queue at CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, VERILATOR_JOBS=1. One remote Quartus job only after local release.

local_validation.focused: R18 prescan + FP wrapper + T016 SV/Cocotb all pass
local_validation.l0_l1: registered union pass; T012 natural FP/data-MMU overlap blocked_cycles=3 consume=1 fp_commits=1 load_commits=1
local_validation.l2: A-F pass; 3400 strict commits plus protocol/semantic guards

board_policy: No Quartus assembler, SOF/JIC/RBF/POF/JBC/SVF/JAM, JTAG, programming, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
